observations.quest_dependencies: Gertrude's Cat grants the kitten required by Icthlarin's Little Helper. Contact! requires Icthlarin's Little Helper and Prince Ali Rescue; completion of the latter is already in the main catalog.
observations.icthlarin: Staged wanderer, first memory, Sphinx/High Priest, canopic jars, embalmer, linen, Carpenter's holy symbol, ritual, fight and completion with all three fixed skill rewards and catspeak amulet.
observations.contact: Staged priest/Jex, bank trapdoor, dungeon, Kaleef, Maisa, Al Kharid Osman, chasm, Giant Scarab, return, Keris, bank unlock and a deferred two-pick combat lamp.
observations.travel: Both pyramid directions, all dungeon exits and public desert access are modeled. Dungeon light is produced by lighting a purchased candle. Magic carpet is already represented by the existing desert catalog.
